title: Data quality, fitness-for-purpose, and mapping audit
purpose: Profiles missingness, duplicates, implausible values, subgroup coverage, and terminology-mapping completeness before AI validation or economic analysis.
input: `Data` sheet with patient/encounter rows; `Mapping` sheet with local field, target standard, code, and required flag.
outputs: Column profile, missingness table and chart, quality checks, subgroup coverage, mapping audit, and summary JSON.
limitations: This is an educational example. It is not a clinical device, validated decision instrument, or substitute for local statistical, economic, legal, privacy, cybersecurity, ethics, quality, or health-technology-assessment review.
